title: derOlf Networks Modpack
description: Lightweight client-side modpack for the derOlf-Network, featuring essential quality-of-life mods, better PvP visibility, and optimized performance.
body:
**Modpack Preview**

This modpack includes a selection of carefully chosen client-side mods that improve gameplay without affecting balance. It is perfect for players who want a clean, optimized, and server-friendly Minecraft experience.

---

🔧 **Features**

- **Better visibility in PvP**  
  Mods like Low Fire and Low Shield help you see more clearly during combat.

- **Improved inventory management**  
  Mouse Tweaks and Shulker Box Tooltip make handling items faster and easier.

- **Integrated voice chat**  
  Simple Voice Chat allows seamless communication with other players.

- **Lightweight & optimized**  
  No unnecessary mods – fast loading times and smooth performance.

---

🎮 **Why use this modpack?**

- Fully compatible with the **derOlf-Network**  
- Includes all allowed and recommended mods  
- No setup required – just install and play  
- Improves gameplay without changing vanilla mechanics  

---

👥 **Who is this for?**

- Players on the **derOlf-Network**  
- PvP-focused players  
- Anyone looking for a simple, lightweight client modpack  

---

⚠️ **Support & Community**

If you encounter bugs or have issues with other players, feel free to join our Discord
